data.name: SftpUserNotFound
data.value: This SFTP user could not be found.

data.name: SftpUserNameTaken
data.value: You already have an SFTP user with this name.

data.name: SftpUserLimitReached
data.value: Your plan does not allow any more SFTP users.

data.name: SftpUserLimitReachedConcurrently
data.value: Your plan's SFTP user limit was reached by another request made at the same moment, so this user was not created and no password was issued. Nothing you entered is wrong. Delete an SFTP user you no longer need, or ask for a larger plan, then try again.

data.name: SftpUserNameTooLong
data.value: This name is too long once your account prefix is added.

data.name: SftpUserNameInvalidFormat
data.value: An SFTP user name may only contain lowercase letters and digits.

data.name: SftpUserProvisioningFailed
data.value: This SFTP user could not be created. Nothing was left behind; please try again.

data.name: AccountNotFound
data.value: This account could not be found.

data.name: SftpKeyLimitReached
data.value: This SFTP user already has the maximum number of public keys. Remove a key you no longer use, then try again.

data.name: SftpKeyDuplicate
data.value: This public key is already added to this SFTP user.

data.name: SftpKeyNotFound
data.value: This public key could not be found.

data.name: SftpKeyInvalid
data.value: This is not a valid public key. Paste a single line in the OpenSSH format, for example one that starts with ssh-ed25519.

data.name: SftpKeyLabelInvalid
data.value: A key label must be 1 to 64 characters long and must not contain control characters.

data.name: SftpSessionsNotEnded
data.value: The key is already refused for new sign-ins, but the open sessions of this SFTP user could not be ended and may still be running. The key is still listed; repeat the removal to end them.

data.name: SftpKeyChangeFailed
data.value: The key change could not be saved. Check the list of keys, then try again.
